description: This PHP source file defines the OpenIdConnectLoginController class responsible for handling OAuth2/OpenID Connect login flow with external providers in the OrangeHRM system. It manages authentication requests, redirects users for consent, and integrates with the social media authentication service.

classes.name: OpenIdConnectLoginController
classes.description: Controller class to manage OpenID Connect login flow, including initiating authentication, handling provider details, and redirecting for user consent.

methods.name: getHomePageService
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of HomePageService, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the login process by retrieving the provider details, initiating authentication, setting user attributes, and redirecting to the consent page.
